analysis.summaryJa: as ... asの前にalmost、just、twice、halfなどを置き、同程度だけでなく近さ・倍率・数量差まで表す。
grammarPoints: not as ... asで劣る程度を示す
twice/half as ... asで倍率を示す
as many/much + 名詞 + asで数量を比べる
visualEvidence: 最初のasの左側に程度語を置く配置が示される
twiceとhalfの矢印が倍率の違いを示す
manyは可算名詞、muchは不可算名詞に結び付く
会話ではasの後に目的格代名詞を置ける
commonTraps: almostを二つのasの間に置かない
twice more thanと混同しない
不可算名詞にmanyを使わない
not asの意味を同程度と誤解しない

questions.prompt: The renovated lobby is almost ------- spacious as the one at our headquarters.

choices.B: most

questions.translationJa: 改装後のロビーは本社のロビーとほぼ同じくらい広いです。
questions.explanationJa: almostは最初のasの前に置き、almost as spacious asを作ります。

questions.prompt: This year's exhibition attracted twice ------- many overseas visitors as last year's event.

choices.B: more

questions.translationJa: 今年の展示会は昨年の2倍の海外来場者を集めました。
questions.explanationJa: 倍率と可算名詞にはtwice as many visitors asを使います。

questions.prompt: The online orientation is not as ------- as the instructor-led session for new technicians.

choices.B: most detailed

questions.translationJa: オンライン研修は新人技術者には講師付き研修ほど詳しくありません。
questions.explanationJa: asとasの間には形容詞の原級detailedを置きます。

questions.prompt: The temporary warehouse can hold half ------- much inventory as the central facility.

choices.B: as

questions.translationJa: 仮設倉庫は中央施設の半分の在庫量を保管できます。
questions.explanationJa: 不可算扱いのinventoryにはhalf as much ... asが適切です。

questions.prompt: The revised application form is just ------- easy to complete as the paper version.

choices.B: more

questions.translationJa: 改訂版申請フォームは紙版とまさに同じくらい記入しやすいです。
questions.explanationJa: justは同程度を強調し、just as easy asとなります。

questions.prompt: The smaller meeting room has nearly as ------- chairs as Conference Room A.

choices.B: more

questions.translationJa: 小さい会議室にもA会議室とほぼ同じ数の椅子があります。
questions.explanationJa: chairsは可算複数なのでas many chairs asを使います。

questions.prompt: The new analyst is as good ------- interpreting sales trends as the senior consultant.

choices.B: at

questions.translationJa: 新しい分析担当者は上級コンサルタントと同じくらい販売動向の解釈が得意です。
questions.explanationJa: be good at doingの形をas ... asで比較します。

questions.prompt: During the trial, the compact battery lasted nearly as long as -------.

choices.B: our

questions.translationJa: 試験中、小型電池は私たちのものとほぼ同じ時間持続しました。
questions.explanationJa: 比較対象のour batteryを受ける所有代名詞oursが必要です。
questions.focus: 比較対象の省略と所有代名詞

questions.prompt: The evening support team responds as quickly as ------- during peak periods.

choices.B: their

questions.translationJa: 繁忙時間には夜間支援チームも彼らと同じ速さで応答します。
questions.explanationJa: 会話的な比較ではasの後に目的格themを置けます。

questions.prompt: The upgraded server processes three times as ------- data as the previous system.

choices.B: many

questions.translationJa: 更新サーバーは旧システムの3倍のデータを処理します。
questions.explanationJa: dataを量として比べるためthree times as much data asを使います。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly compares the two service plans?

choices.A: The basic plan is not as more flexible as the premium plan.
choices.B: The basic plan is not as flexible as the premium plan.
choices.C: The basic plan is not flexible as the premium plan.
choices.D: The basic plan is not as flexiblest as the premium plan.

questions.translationJa: 基本プランはプレミアムプランほど柔軟ではありません。
questions.explanationJa: not as ... asの間には原級flexibleを置きます。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly states the visitor ratio?

choices.A: The annex received twice many visitors as the gallery.
choices.B: The annex received as twice many visitors as the gallery.
choices.C: The annex received twice more visitors as the gallery.
choices.D: The annex received twice as many visitors as the gallery.

questions.translationJa: 別館にはギャラリーの2倍の来場者がありました。
questions.explanationJa: 倍率はtwice as many + 可算名詞 + asの順です。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly describes nearly equal speed?

choices.A: The replacement unit starts almost as quickly as the original.
choices.B: The replacement unit starts as almost quickly as the original.
choices.C: The replacement unit starts almost more quickly as the original.
choices.D: The replacement unit starts almost quickest than the original.

questions.translationJa: 交換機は元の機器とほぼ同じ速さで起動します。
questions.explanationJa: almostは最初のasの前、quicklyは原級で置きます。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly compares document length?

choices.A: The summary is half short as the report.
choices.B: The summary is as half long as the report.
choices.C: The summary is half as long as the report.
choices.D: The summary is half longer than the report.

questions.translationJa: 要約は報告書の半分の長さです。
questions.explanationJa: halfは最初のasの前に置き、half as long asとします。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly compares available space?

choices.A: The east storeroom has as much space than the west one.
choices.B: The east storeroom has much as space as the west one.
choices.C: The east storeroom has as many space as the west one.
choices.D: The east storeroom has as much space as the west one.

questions.translationJa: 東の保管室には西の保管室と同じくらいの空間があります。
questions.explanationJa: spaceは不可算なのでas much space asが正しい形です。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly compares presentation skill?

choices.A: Ms. Wu is as good presenting as Mr. Hall.
choices.B: Ms. Wu is good at as presenting as Mr. Hall.
choices.C: Ms. Wu is as good at presenting as Mr. Hall.
choices.D: Ms. Wu is as better at presenting than Mr. Hall.

questions.translationJa: ウーさんはホールさんと同じくらい発表が得意です。
questions.explanationJa: as good at presenting asの語順が必要です。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly uses an object pronoun after as?

choices.A: The interns finished as early as they.
choices.B: The interns finished as early as them.
choices.C: The interns finished as earlier as them.
choices.D: The interns finished earlier as them.

questions.translationJa: 研修生たちは彼らと同じくらい早く終えました。
questions.explanationJa: 会話的な省略構文ではasの後に目的格themを置けます。
questions.focus: 目的格による比較対象

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly expresses almost equal attendance?

choices.A: We had nearly as many participants as the host company.
choices.B: We had as nearly many participants as the host company.
choices.C: We had nearly as much participants as the host company.
choices.D: We had nearly more participants as the host company.

questions.translationJa: 当社には主催会社とほぼ同じ人数の参加者がいました。
questions.explanationJa: participantsは可算なのでnearly as many ... asを用います。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly compares two budgets?

choices.A: The pilot used just as many money as the full project.
choices.B: The pilot used as just much money as the full project.
choices.C: The pilot used just more money as the full project.
choices.D: The pilot used just as much money as the full project.

questions.translationJa: 試行事業は本事業とまさに同額の資金を使いました。
questions.explanationJa: moneyは不可算で、just as much money asが正しい形です。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly states an exact equality?

choices.A: The updated guide is as more useful as the old one.
choices.B: The updated guide is just as useful as the old one.
choices.C: The updated guide is just useful than the old one.
choices.D: The updated guide is the just most useful as the old one.

questions.translationJa: 更新版の手引きは旧版とまさに同じくらい役立ちます。
questions.explanationJa: just as useful asで同程度を強調します。

questions.prompt: The satellite office is not as large as the main office.

choices.A: The two offices are exactly the same size.
choices.B: The satellite office is the largest office.
choices.C: The main office is smaller than the satellite office.
choices.D: The satellite office is smaller than the main office.

questions.translationJa: 支所は本社ほど大きくありません。
questions.explanationJa: not as large asは比較対象より小さいことを表します。

questions.prompt: The new campaign generated twice as many inquiries as the previous one.

choices.A: The campaigns generated the same number of inquiries.
choices.B: The new campaign generated two times the number of inquiries.
choices.C: The previous campaign generated twice as many inquiries.
choices.D: The new campaign generated half as many inquiries.

questions.translationJa: 新キャンペーンは前回の2倍の問い合わせを生みました。
questions.explanationJa: twice as manyは数量が2倍という意味です。

questions.prompt: The trial system is almost as stable as the production system.

choices.A: The trial system is completely unstable.
choices.B: The trial system is much more stable.
choices.C: Their stability is very close, though not necessarily identical.
choices.D: The production system is being replaced today.

questions.translationJa: 試験システムは本番システムとほぼ同じくらい安定しています。
questions.explanationJa: almost as ... asは完全一致ではないが差が小さいことを示します。

questions.prompt: The compact venue can seat half as many guests as the ballroom.

choices.A: Its seating capacity is 50 percent of the ballroom's.
choices.B: It seats twice as many guests as the ballroom.

questions.translationJa: 小会場の座席数は大宴会場の半分です。
questions.explanationJa: half as manyは数量が50パーセントであることを表します。

questions.prompt: This branch uses three times as much electricity as the training center.

choices.A: The training center uses three times more than the branch.
choices.B: The branch's electricity use is triple the training center's.
choices.D: The branch uses one-third as much electricity.

questions.translationJa: この支店は研修センターの3倍の電力を使います。
questions.explanationJa: three times as muchは量が3倍という意味です。

questions.prompt: Ms. Kato is as good at resolving complaints as her supervisor.

choices.A: She has never handled a complaint.
choices.B: Her supervisor resolves every complaint faster.
choices.C: She is less capable than all supervisors.
choices.D: Her complaint-handling ability matches her supervisor's.

questions.translationJa: 加藤さんは上司と同じくらい苦情対応が得意です。
questions.explanationJa: as good at ... asは能力が同程度であることを示します。

questions.prompt: The revised checklist is just as thorough as the original.

choices.A: The two checklists are equally thorough.
choices.B: The revised checklist omits every item.
choices.C: The original is much less thorough.
choices.D: Only the revised checklist is available.

questions.translationJa: 改訂チェックリストは元のものとまさに同じくらい綿密です。
questions.explanationJa: justは等しさを強調し、程度が同じだと表します。

questions.prompt: The webinar drew nearly as many viewers as the product launch.

choices.B: The webinar had far more viewers.
choices.C: The viewer totals were close, but not stated as exactly equal.

questions.translationJa: ウェビナーは製品発表会とほぼ同数の視聴者を集めました。
questions.explanationJa: nearly as manyは数量が近いことを示します。

questions.prompt: The sample package weighs one-third as much as the commercial package.

choices.A: Its weight is about 33 percent of the commercial package's.
choices.B: It weighs three times as much.
choices.C: Both packages have the same weight.
choices.D: The commercial package is one-third as heavy.

questions.translationJa: 見本包装の重量は市販包装の3分の1です。
questions.explanationJa: one-third as muchは基準量の約33パーセントです。

questions.prompt: The temporary staff completed just as many orders as the permanent staff.

choices.A: The temporary staff completed no orders.
choices.B: The permanent staff completed twice as many.
choices.C: The order totals were not compared.
choices.D: Both groups completed the same number of orders.

questions.translationJa: 臨時職員と常勤職員は同数の注文を処理しました。
questions.explanationJa: just as many orders asは注文数が同じことを強調します。

questions.prompt: The new brochure has fewer pages, but it covers every required topic. It is ------- the longer brochure for first-time visitors.

choices.B: the most useful than

questions.translationJa: 新しい冊子は短いものの、初回訪問者には長い冊子と同じくらい役立ちます。
questions.explanationJa: but以下の同等性にはjust as useful asが合います。

questions.prompt: Last year's fair occupied two halls. This year's event will use four halls and accommodate ------- exhibitors as last year.

choices.B: twice as many

questions.translationJa: 今年は4会場を使い、昨年の2倍の出展者を収容します。
questions.explanationJa: 会場数が二倍でexhibitorsは可算なのでtwice as manyが自然です。

questions.prompt: The portable generator has a smaller fuel tank. At full load, it runs ------- the stationary model.

choices.B: twice as long as

questions.translationJa: 携帯発電機は燃料タンクが小さく、全負荷では固定型の半分の時間しか稼働しません。
questions.explanationJa: 小さいタンクという文脈からhalf as long asが適切です。

questions.prompt: Both applicants passed the software test with identical scores. Ms. Evans performed ------- Mr. Diaz.

choices.B: more well as

questions.translationJa: 両応募者は同点で、エバンスさんはディアスさんとまさに同じくらい良い成績でした。
questions.explanationJa: 同点を受け、動作の同等性を示すjust as well asを選びます。
questions.focus: as well asによる同等比較

questions.prompt: The first prototype was far too heavy. The latest version weighs nearly ------- the target model.

choices.B: most as

questions.translationJa: 最新試作品の重量は目標機種とほぼ同じです。
questions.explanationJa: 重量という量にはnearly as much asが適切です。

questions.prompt: The downtown kiosk has only six shelves, whereas the airport shop has twelve. It can display ------- products as the airport shop.

choices.B: as much

questions.translationJa: 中心街の売店は棚が半数なので、空港店の半分の商品数を陳列できます。
questions.explanationJa: 6対12の数量関係にはhalf as many products asが合います。

questions.prompt: The two representatives received the same customer rating. According to the survey, Ms. Long communicates ------- Mr. Reed.

choices.B: more clear as

questions.translationJa: 同じ評価だったため、ロングさんはリードさんと同じくらい明瞭に意思疎通します。
questions.explanationJa: communicatesを副詞clearlyで同等比較します。

questions.prompt: The regional team spent ¥2 million on the campaign, while headquarters spent ¥4 million. The regional team spent ------- headquarters.

choices.B: half as much as

questions.translationJa: 地域チームの支出は本社の半分でした。
questions.explanationJa: 2対4なのでhalf as much asが唯一正しいです。

questions.prompt: The updated search tool found 98 percent of the records located by the full system. It is ------- the full system in this test.

choices.B: almost as effective as

questions.translationJa: 更新検索ツールはこの試験で本システムとほぼ同じくらい有効です。
questions.explanationJa: 98パーセントという近い値にはalmost as effective asが適切です。

questions.prompt: The two departments processed exactly 640 requests each. The compliance unit handled ------- the service unit.

choices.B: the most requests of

questions.translationJa: 両部門が各640件処理したため、コンプライアンス部門はサービス部門とまさに同数を扱いました。
questions.explanationJa: 可算複数requestsと同数にはjust as many ... asを使います。
